channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Katy ISD Dedicates Boudny Elementary, Honoring Educators' 75 Years of Service
item.description: Katy ISD dedicated its newest elementary school Monday night, honoring educators Alfred and Ann Boudny before hundreds of community members, district officials and elected officials.

item.title: Alamo Drafthouse to be Replaced by Flix Brewhouse
item.description: Flix Brewhouse is acquiring four Texas dine-in cinema locations formerly operated by Triple Tap Ventures as an Alamo Drafthouse franchisee, including the LaCenterra location in Cinco Ranch.

item.title: Texas regulators agree to review Katy's rejection of battery storage facility
item.description: he Texas Public Utility Commission is expected to take up the case of Ochoa Energy Storage's application to build a 500-megawatt Battery Energy Storage System facility in Katy

item.title: Taylor takes oath as City Council now has three women – a first for Katy
item.description: Paula Taylor took the oath of office Monday in a historic first: Katy City Council now has three women members for the first time ever.

item.title: Katy Council advances plan to save iconic Cardiff Rice Dryer and other historic structures
item.description: The Katy City Council voted Monday to create a historic preservation committee that could save the city's iconic 177-foot Rice Dryer and other landmarks threatened by modern building codes that can make redevelopment very difficult.

item.title: Digitally altered photo circulates in Fort Bend County race for County Clerk
item.description: Every day seems to bring a new racially charged attack on Republican county clerk candidate J.J. Clemence, an immigrant from China who has been an active member of the Fort Bend Republican Party for 20 years.

item.title: Lamar CISD superintendent named National Superintendent of the Year
item.description: Lamar Consolidated Independent School District Superintendent Dr. Roosevelt Nivens has been named the 2026 AASA National Superintendent of the Year.

item.title: School of Rock Fulshear Announces Grand Opening March 2 and Free Community Open House Feb. 28
item.description: Fort Bend County is turning up the volume. School of Rock Fulshear will open its doors Monday, March 2, bringing performance-based music education to the growing Fulshear community and nearby neighborhoods. \

item.title: Houston Texans to Build New Headquarters and Practice Facility in Bridgeland near Katy
item.description: Harris County commissioners approved a memorandum of understanding Wednesday to pursue a public-private partnership with the Houston Texans and Howard Hughes Holdings that would create a mixed-use sports and entertainment destination in Bridgeland.

item.title: Tamara McFarlane Caught Being Untruthful About Endorsement
item.description: Bend County Clerk Candidate Tamara McFarlane has been posting that she's been endorsed by Steve Toth, a Republican State Representative from the Woodlands, but Toth says he's not endorsing anyone.
